prompt:
Generate exactly ONE photorealistic photograph, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 pixels.
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: main photo for the window tint service page of a Korean car care shop with a dark, calm, refined website.
Subject and framing: close-up of window tint being applied to the rear side window of an anonymous gloss black sedan, viewed from outside the car. A black-gloved hand presses a plain dark squeegee across a sheet of dark tint film on the glass. Show a thin film of water and a few small water droplets, with the film edge neatly trimmed along the window frame. Only gloved hands and part of a forearm in a black sleeve are visible; no face or person's head.
Setting: dark, clean detailing studio with a near-black background. Long white linear LED light strips overhead reflect as clean lines on the glossy black paint and glass. Polished dark floor out of focus.
Style and lighting: premium professional automotive service photography, dark and calm, true colours, crisp realistic material detail, detailed blacks, controlled highlights, no HDR halos and no motion blur.
Strict exclusions: no badges, emblems, logos, licence plate, text, letters, numbers or watermarks anywhere, including on the film, tools and reflections. No visible head, face or additional person. Opaque image background.
